# Issue Guidelines

Thank you for contributing to **WERR (Waves & Errors)**!

Please choose one of our structured issue forms:
- [🐛 Bug Report](https://github.com/pCwOrM/werr/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- [💡 Feature Request / Proposal](https://github.com/pCwOrM/werr/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
- [🔬 Benchmark Replication Report](https://github.com/pCwOrM/werr/issues/new?template=replication_report.yml)

For general inquiries, ideas, and architecture discussions, please join [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/pCwOrM/werr/discussions).
